name: Pyogenic Flexor Tenosynovitis of the Hand
tags: pyogenic flexor tenosynovitis of the hand
definition: Closed-space infection of a digital flexor tendon sheath that can rapidly damage tendon and soft tissues.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; labs and imaging support but should not delay urgent hand-surgery assessment.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Early cases may occasionally be treated nonoperatively under specialist supervision, but delayed treatment risks tendon necrosis.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta-Shotha framework is secondary to emergency infection control.

patientEducation.summary: Closed-space infection of a digital flexor tendon sheath that can rapidly damage tendon and soft tissues.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
